methodologicalConstraints: Internet Archive full-text OCR is a machine derivative and does not preserve a trustworthy reading order for the two-column page.
The OCR may establish that a guide string is present, but it is not sufficient authority for uncertain Cahita forms or for an exhaustive visible-start denominator.
BUE1890 is a later reprint/control witness and is never silently substituted for ALC1737.
No precision, recall or F1 value is claimable until a facsimile-level exhaustive visible-start census exists.
decisions: R-011 is reclassified from unresolved to article because the primary OCR preserves the guide start and BUE1890 independently corroborates the segmentation.
R-011 remains pending_promotion because the exact ALC1737 Cahita form is not sufficiently reliable from OCR alone.
R-012 remains an article with ambiguous boundary assessment and pending_promotion; its guide is identified as Atomo, but its exact ALC1737 Cahita form remains too uncertain for promotion.
No BUE1890 form is silently substituted for ALC1737.
The recovered full-text derivative strengthens reproducibility but does not by itself close the facsimile-level visible-start census.
